_description: Workflow for keeping current Material Function docs usable by ForgePilot, Codex, Claude, and other AI agents.
goal: Let agents understand the available Material Function categories, pick useful reusable blocks, and avoid rebuilding large graph chunks from primitive expressions when a validated function already exists.
workflow: Regenerate the broad material node catalog when the UE version or engine content changes.

Run export_material_function_docs.ps1 with IncludeFunctionInfo and IncludeInternalGraph to scan /Engine/Functions through the bridge Asset Registry, filter actual MaterialFunction assets, and inspect every real Engine MaterialFunction through get_material_function_info.
Read the generated category markdown docs before choosing a MaterialFunctionCall for a production graph.
Use material_function_usage_strategy.json for the expression-versus-function decision rules.
Use run_material_function_probe.ps1 for curated high-value VFX functions that must remain callable through the bridge.
For a selected function, inspect it again with get_material_function_info immediately before wiring because function pins are the highest-risk part of automation.
Wire inputs by target_input_name rather than raw input index.
guardrails: Do not assume Material Functions are faster than equivalent expressions; they are mainly cleaner and more reusable.
Do not use ExampleContent, NotInUse, MAXScripts, SupportFiles, Strata, or MaterialLayerFunctions blindly in particle VFX materials.
Do not wire function pins by guessed index when target_input_name is available.
Do not replace simple one-node or two-node math with functions unless the function exposes clearer artist-facing controls.
catalog_caution: The file-system catalog may see every .uasset under Engine/Content/Functions, including textures, example materials, and support assets. The function study exporter uses scan_assets with asset_type MaterialFunction when IncludeFunctionInfo is enabled, so the semantic docs are based on real MaterialFunction assets rather than folder contents alone.
deep_graph_rule: Generated function docs under Docs/MaterialFunctions/Current/Functions contain exact internal nodes, pin wiring, connection lists, and output trace roots. Use those docs as graph truth before explaining or rebuilding a function.
semantic_notes_rule: Deep graph docs provide structure, but they do not always compress a graph into a clean artist-facing formula. For high-value functions where artists need exact behavior, add a hand-traced entry to material_function_semantic_notes_current.json.
